experiment: Exp 2 — N=3 code/JSON workload only (workload-dependency probe)
engine: llama.cpp build 8889 (bcb5eeb64), post PR #22227 speculative-simple checkpoint support
draft_model: Qwen3.5-0.8B-Q4_K_M.gguf (~508 MB, vocab-SIZE-matched only; llama.cpp's compatibility gate REJECTS the pair and falls back to token translation - see ERRATA A2)

prompts.2: REST API JSON spec for user authentication

interpretation: EXPLORATORY (rescoped 2026-08-25). Under the commands actually executed, code/JSON prompts did not flip speculative decoding positive: baseline 139.22 tok/s, oleg --draft-min 2 --draft-max 32 66.57 (-52.2%), srogmann --draft-min 48 --draft-max 64 83.84 (-39.8%). The intended treatment - direct, thinking-disabled, low-entropy code/JSON output - was NOT verified: -no-cnv is rejected by llama-cli on this build, /no_think did not disable thinking, and per-request outputs were not committed. This experiment therefore does not refute the low-entropy workload hypothesis; it is a command-level replication of the negative direction. See audit_2026_08_25.

audit_2026_08_25.status: EXPLORATORY - the intended treatment was not verified
what_was_retracted: The previous `interpretation` field ended: 'Workload-shape hypothesis (joshua Spark NVFP4 idea) is REFUTED for this hardware/engine.' That conclusion is withdrawn.
The README described this result as showing the regression is 'structural'. Withdrawn: one host, one quantisation, three configs, five prompts, and no mechanism measurement cannot establish that.
why: The runner passes `-no-cnv` to llama-cli. Committed logs from the SAME build (8889 / bcb5eeb64) in ../v2_master_cross_check/ show llama-cli printing '--no-conversation is not supported by llama-cli / please use llama-completion instead'.

The prompts append `/no_think`. Logs from the same build show `[Start thinking]` followed by a full reasoning trace, so thinking was not disabled. The real switches on this build are `-rea off` and `--reasoning-budget 0`.

Only timing summaries were committed. run_n3_codejson.sh writes per-prompt logs to $HOME/bench/n3_codejson_*/trial_N/cfg/pI.log; those were never added to the repository, so the generated text, token IDs, and stop reasons are gone and the intended 'direct, low-entropy code/JSON output' distribution cannot be audited.
The draft model was not vocabulary-matched: llama.cpp fell back to token translation because the 0.8B GGUF carries no tokenizer.ggml.bos_token_id. See ../../ERRATA.md item A2.
what_still_holds: Under the command as executed, both draft configurations were slower than the no-speculation arm on every prompt.

The command is highly repeatable. Decomposing the 15 cells per config: the SD of the three trial means is 0.111 / 0.058 / 0.053 tok/s for 01_baseline / 02_oleg_draft_2_32 / 03_srogmann_draft_48_64, while the SD over all 15 cells is 0.455 / 7.566 / 1.804. The published '66.57 +/- 7.57' is spread BETWEEN PROMPTS, not run-to-run noise.
audit_2026_08_25.target_artifact_note: The target is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_XL. Q4_K_M in this repository always refers to the 0.8B draft model.
valid_retest_requires: llama-completion, or a chat-template thinking toggle verified in the output
committed per-request text, token IDs, and stop reasons
a check that outputs actually satisfy the code/JSON constraint before any workload-boundary claim is made
one pinned binary, ABBA ordering, and >= 5 repeats per cell
